preview.marketIocHint: Sent as a market IOC inside the venue's price-limit band.
preview.limitPxHint: Reduce-only IOC limit at mid ± slippage — fills what it can at once, never rests, never adds
preview.hedgeAtMarketNote: — first leg limit at mid ± slippage; hedge leg at market

bits.swapVenuesHint: Swap the long and short venues
bits.autoHint: Auto-chosen: the cheapest maker+taker fee combo
bits.savingHint: Open-fee saving vs both legs taker
bits.makerPriceHint: Defaults to one bid–ask gap behind the touch and follows the book until you type a price.
bits.tracking: tracking the book — type to pin
bits.bookUnavailableHint: Order book unavailable. The price is a cross-venue mid estimate — verify before executing.
bits.convertHint: Unfilled remainder cancels and completes as market orders on both venues after this long
bits.makerChipHint: Rests post-only one bid–ask gap behind the same-side touch; the other leg auto-hedges as it fills
bits.partialDepth: {{venue}}: partial depth — estimate extrapolated past the book
bits.bookHint: Show or hide the live book and market-impact graph
bits.marginRequiredHint: Initial margin the two legs post together — each leg's notional over its leverage

closeBoros.legsReasonAll: These legs are sized in different collateral ({{list}}), so one size cannot apply to all of them. Close them one at a time from the legs table.
closeBoros.legsReasonBoth: These legs are sized in different collateral ({{list}}), so one size cannot apply to both. Close them one at a time from the legs table.
closeBoros.agentReason: This build cannot close Boros legs. Close them in the Boros app.
closeBoros.noPositionToClose: There was no open position to close.
closeBoros.cancelledNoPosition: Resting orders were cancelled, but there was no open position to close.
closeBoros.noLegs: No Boros legs on this position.
closeBoros.closedDone_one: Leg closed. The position is re-reading from the venue now — the card updates on its own.
closeBoros.closedDone_other: {{count}} legs closed. The position is re-reading from the venue now — the card updates on its own.
closeBoros.residualYours: {{amount}} of this position is still open — you closed part of it. Close the rest whenever you like.
closeBoros.residualOthers: {{amount}} more is open on the venue — that is another position's share of the same leg, not yours.
closeBoros.closeWholeEvery: Close the whole position on every leg
closeBoros.sizeAria: Close size, applied to all legs
closeBoros.sizeInvalid: size must be above 0 and at most {{max}} {{unit}}
closeBoros.wholePairAll: whole pair · flat after on all {{n}} markets
closeBoros.wholePairBoth: whole pair · flat after on both markets
closeBoros.sharedHint: Part of a venue leg another position also holds. That part stays open.
closeBoros.sharedLabel: this position's share · the rest of the shared leg stays open
closeBoros.cappedHint: The size is capped at what is open, so it can never cross past flat.
closeBoros.legClosed: {{prefix}}This leg is closed; it will not be sent again.
closeBoros.legClosedYours: {{prefix}}This leg is closed; it will not be sent again. {{amount}} of it is still open — you closed part.
closeBoros.bookShort: {{prefix}}the book only supports {{amount}} {{unit}} of this size — it will fill short
closeBoros.bookUnavailable: {{prefix}}order book unavailable — no rate can be quoted for this leg
closeBoros.partFilled: {{prefix}}filled {{filled}} {{unit}} — {{left}} {{unit}} of what you asked for is still open. The size above is set to what is left; close again to finish it.
closeBoros.estRateHint: Market order after cancelling any resting orders on this market
closeBoros.estFeeHint: Boros taker fee on this order: rate × size × time to maturity
closeBoros.slipTitle: The worst APR this close accepts, per leg. A close that misses it leaves the position open.
closeBoros.slipHint: Max rate this close will accept. A wider tolerance may be needed for a large size or a thin book.
closeBoros.unquoted: No quote is available for this market. The close still goes out, within {{slip}}% of mid.
closeBoros.footOnePerps: Cancels resting orders, then sends 1 market order. The perps stay open.
closeBoros.footOnePerp: Cancels resting orders, then sends 1 market order. The perp stays open.
closeBoros.footLeft_one: Cancels resting orders, then closes the leg left in one batch, all or none.
closeBoros.footLeft_other: Cancels resting orders, then closes the {{count}} legs left in one batch, all or none.
closeBoros.footAll: Cancels resting orders, then closes all {{n}} legs in one batch, all or none.
closeBoros.footBoth: Cancels resting orders, then closes both legs in one batch, all or none.

pair.pegNote: maker price pegs to the touch at submit

borosBits.longRateHint: Long the rate — pay fixed, receive floating
borosBits.shortRateHint: Short the rate — receive fixed, pay floating
borosBits.liqTitle: The mark rate at which this leg is liquidated if only its required margin backs it — extra collateral in the bucket moves it further out.
borosBits.liqNaHint: Position risk is low, so there is no liquidation rate for the time being.
borosBits.spreadHint:
Net of settlement fees. Execution rates at this size:
{{rates}}
borosBits.positionAfterHint: Boros nets to one position per market, so this is your WHOLE exposure there — not just the part this ticket opens.
borosBits.marginFreedHint: Initial margin these legs stop posting once they are closed — it returns to the bucket each one sits in.
borosBits.totalMarginHint: The two legs summed, not netted: each bucket must carry its own margin.
borosBits.bucketMarginHint: Initial margin this leg's bucket must carry
borosBits.tradeFeeHint: Boros taker fee at this size — charged once, when the order fills
borosBits.tradeFeeLegsHint: Boros taker fee on both legs at this size — charged once, when the orders fill
borosBits.isolatedSwitch: Cancel its orders and close the position on Boros first.
borosBits.uneven: Only {{hedged}} {{unit}} fills on both legs. {{unhedged}} {{unit}} would be left unhedged.
borosBits.unhedged: {{size}} {{unit}} on leg {{letter}} is unhedged — that size is directional until you complete or close it.
borosBits.ackFlip: I understand this closes my existing {{market}} {{side}} position of {{held}} {{unit}}, realising its PnL, and opens {{opened}} {{unit}} in the opposite direction.
borosBits.ackClose: I understand this closes my existing {{market}} {{side}} position of {{held}} {{unit}} in full, realising its PnL.
borosBits.ackReduce: I understand this reduces my existing {{market}} {{side}} position of {{held}} {{unit}} to {{to}} {{unit}}, realising part of its PnL.

hint.insufficientDepth: The book ran out inside your rate bound. Trade a smaller size, or widen the tolerance and re-issue.
hint.rateDeviation: The chain refused the rate as too far from mark. Widening your tolerance will not help — wait for the mark to move.
hint.insufficientMargin: That account could not fund the leg. Top it up, then re-issue.
hint.noGas: Boros bills each action to a prepaid gas pot, which is separate from your trading collateral. Top up the gas balance, then re-issue.
hint.minCash: This is the first trade on this collateral on Boros, and the venue needs a minimum balance in that account before it will accept one. This is collateral, not gas: topping up the gas balance will not clear it. Deposit into your Boros balance for this collateral, then re-issue.
hint.marketLimit: This collateral account is in as many Boros markets as it may hold, and each one still has a position or an order. Close a position you no longer need, then re-issue.
hint.rejected: The venue rejected the order outright — its own message is below.
hint.unknown: This leg needs checking on Boros:

boros.slipOutOfRange: Max slippage must be greater than 0 and at most {{max}}% APR — the order would otherwise carry a rate bound you did not choose.
boros.staleQuote: The quote is out of date — waiting for a fresh one.
boros.completingLeg: Completing leg {{letter}} only — one order, sized to the residual. The other leg is untouched.
boros.closeOnlyHint: This market only accepts orders that reduce your position.
boros.swapSidesHint: Swap long and short on the spread
boros.swapMarketsHint: Swap the two markets between their slots
boros.noSharedMaturity: {{a}} and {{b}} share no maturity, so they can't be paired.
boros.maxReduceHint: The most reduce-only can take off: the smaller position held. Click to size to it.
boros.maxOpenHint: The largest size your collateral can open: initial margin plus the taker fee, at the current rate. Click to size to it.
boros.maxOpenBothHint: The largest size your collateral can open on both legs: initial margin plus the taker fee, at the current rate. Click to size to it.
boros.maxOpenFreeHint: The largest size your collateral can open: initial margin plus the taker fee, at the current rate, out of {{free}} free. Click to size to it.
boros.maxOpenBothFreeHint: The largest size your collateral can open on both legs: initial margin plus the taker fee, at the current rate, out of {{free}} free. Click to size to it.
boros.reduceOnlyHint: Enforced here by capping the size at your current position — Boros has no reduce-only order type, so check the resulting-position row. Resting orders on the traded markets are cancelled in the same batch.
boros.reduceOnlyNote: caps the size at your open position · cancels resting orders
boros.slippageHint: How far this size walks the books away from mid: the mid spread less the spread you actually get, both legs together. The bound caps the RATE, not the fill — a leg that cannot fill inside it simply stops filling.
boros.changeTolerancePair: Change the tolerance — set per leg ({{slip}}% each), so the pair's worst case is twice it
boros.slipEditorHint: Max rate the order will accept. A wider tolerance may be needed for a large size or a thin book.
boros.slipInvalid: Must be greater than 0 and at most {{max}}%.
boros.oneValue: use one value for both legs
boros.replayed: This is the earlier submission's result, replayed — this confirm did not send a new order.
boros.atomicHint: One atomic batch — neither leg trades unless both are accepted, but each can still fill short.
boros.closeOnlyMarket: Market takes closes only. Tick Reduce-only.
boros.closeOnlyLeg: Market {{letter}} takes closes only. Tick Reduce-only.
